entities.summary: Rodney Jones is an American jazz guitarist who worked with Jaki Byard, Chico Hamilton, Dizzy Gillespie, and Lena Horne and as a bandleader. He is cited as a jazz guitarist who uses modern quartal harmony. Jones is a faculty member at Juilliard. Rodney Jones was a composers & musicians from New Haven (b. 1956-08-30, New Haven). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
